sources.title: GitHub - SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0
sources.snippet: Xiaomi-OCR-0 is a unified 0.8B vision-language model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, it is trained on an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus with Q-Mask text anchoring, continued pretraining (CPT), and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL).
